info.name: Common Room Core Activities Organizations API

params.name: cols
params.description:
Comma-separated list of additional columns to include in the response.
Valid values: `about`, `contactsCount`, `employees`, `linkedInUrl`, `profiles`,
`revenueRangeMax`, `revenueRangeMin`, `subIndustry`, `location`, `leadScores`,
`recentJobOpenings`, `recentNews`, `researchResults`, `surgingTopics`, `tags`, `topContacts`, `url`.
Use `cf_*` to include all custom fields, or `cf_<id>` for a specific one.

items.docs: Retrieve a specific organization by its unique identifier.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of organizations to return per page

params.name: cursor
params.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response

params.name: sort
params.description:
Field to sort results by. One of: `id`, `member_count`,
a lead-score ID (format `ls_<number>`), or a custom-field ID (format `cf_<number>`).

params.name: cols
params.description:
Comma-separated list of additional columns to include in the response.
Valid column values: `about`, `contactsCount`, `employees`, `linkedInUrl`, `profiles`,
`revenueRangeMax`, `revenueRangeMin`, `subIndustry`, `location`, `leadScores`,
`recentJobOpenings`, `recentNews`, `researchResults`, `surgingTopics`, `tags`, `topContacts`, `url`.
Use `cf_*` to include all custom fields, or `cf_<id>` for a specific one. The meta
column `recordCount` can be requested to return the total number of matching
organizations in `meta.recordCount`.

params.name: name
params.description: Filter organizations by exact name match

params.name: primaryDomain
params.description: Filter organizations by primary domain (exact match)

items.docs: Retrieve a list of organizations with pagination support.
